nasa.title: Black Marble 2016
nasa.transformation: Unchanged full-resolution source; separate ≤2400 px JPEG. Composite, not a single instantaneous exposure.

eia.title: EIA International primary energy consumption
eia.transformation: Annual productId=44, activityId=2, unit=QBTU. Join ISO3 with WDI GDP/population; filter type c, positive/matching data. Convert IT Btu to J then kWh/person/day with 365-day year. No EI series used.

wb_gdp_ppp.title: GDP per capita PPP, constant 2021 international dollars
wb_gdp_ppp.licence: CC BY 4.0 as explicitly served by WDI
wb_gdp_ppp.transformation: Use matching 2024 for country plot; latest 2025 population for fusion inventories and deployment. World aggregate is WLD. GDP PPP is not market-exchange-rate GDP. Country/economy metadata excludes World Bank aggregates.

wb_population.title: Population, total
wb_population.licence: CC BY 4.0 as explicitly served by WDI
wb_population.transformation: Use matching 2024 for country plot; latest 2025 population for fusion inventories and deployment. World aggregate is WLD. GDP PPP is not market-exchange-rate GDP. Country/economy metadata excludes World Bank aggregates.

wb_gdp_austria.title: Austria GDP per capita, current local currency (EUR)
wb_gdp_austria.licence: CC BY 4.0 as explicitly served by WDI
wb_gdp_austria.transformation: Use matching 2024 for country plot; latest 2025 population for fusion inventories and deployment. World aggregate is WLD. GDP PPP is not market-exchange-rate GDP. Country/economy metadata excludes World Bank aggregates.

wb_electricity.title: Access to electricity, percent of population
wb_electricity.licence: CC BY 4.0 as explicitly served by WDI
wb_electricity.transformation: Use matching 2024 for country plot; latest 2025 population for fusion inventories and deployment. World aggregate is WLD. GDP PPP is not market-exchange-rate GDP. Country/economy metadata excludes World Bank aggregates.

wb_cooking.title: Clean cooking access, WDI EG.CFT.ACCS.ZS
wb_cooking.licence: Specific WDI source note says CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO; excluded despite the blanket CC BY label
wb_cooking.transformation: No value or series is copied into processed data, plot payloads, the numerical ledger or the chapter. The local research snapshot is ignored by Git. Specific source terms override blanket OWID/WDI terms.

dollarstreet.title: Four stoves across household living standards
dollarstreet.transformation: Extract first-party currentThing metadata; income is PPP-adjusted monthly per equivalent adult (modified OECD scale), NOT total monthly household income. Displayed income estimates approximate ±25%. Download images.original; uncropped URLs return 404.

gapminder_income_levels.title: World population by four income levels, Factfulness notes p.32
gapminder_income_levels.licence: CC BY 4.0; Factfulness notes version 3 and Gapminder estimates
gapminder_income_levels.transformation: Transcribed the four rounded 2017 population estimates; thresholds are 2011 PPP USD/person/day. Counts derive from PovcalNet 2013 and Gapminder extensions/IMF forecasts, not a current survey.

legacy_handwriting.title: Chris bottom-up estimate and stock scenarios
legacy_handwriting.licence: Lecturer original handwritten calculations; original teaching content CC BY 4.0
legacy_handwriting.transformation: Transcribe handwriting independently; do not reuse underlying legacy pages, book charts, maps or photographs. All 35 pages inspected via rendered contact sheets; pages 10/14/29 also full size. No legacy page/image copied to repo.

stat_balance.title: Preliminary Austrian energy balance in TJ
stat_balance.licence: Custom permission: accurate attributed reproduction/distribution/processing; not a named CC licence
stat_balance.transformation: Extract Balance rows 3–19; AL total column (37 zero-based). Sankey uses aggregate coal/oil/gas/renewables/waste plus net-electricity imports. Transformation input minus output is net loss; final carrier × sector cells retained. Mark partial/processed and preliminary. data.statistik.gv.at CC terms do not automatically cover this ODS.

stat_population.title: Austria annual-average population
stat_population.licence: Same custom Statistics Austria attributed-reuse permission
stat_population.transformation: Use pre-existing project-authoritative 9204460.875 annual-average value, compiled 2026-06-29; do not replace with year-end WDI population. Existing data/energy.json remains unchanged.

bgr.title: BGR Energiedaten 2025, data 2024
bgr.licence: BGR workbook is free to download; BGR graphics carry a separate CC BY notice. Numerical data are re-plotted with attribution per lecturer data-reuse policy; no CC licence is asserted for the workbook.
bgr.transformation: World rows of A-10/11 oil, A-17/18 gas, A-23 hard coal, A-30 lignite, A-35 uranium. Production 2024 is H, not C, in time-series sheets. Uranium reserves are low-cost RAR <USD80/kg; broad Red Book identified resources separate. Native mass/volume R/P; published rounded EJ for inventory-power scenarios.

redbook.title: IAEA/NEA Uranium 2024 (2025 publication)
redbook.licence: CC BY 4.0, explicit publication front matter
redbook.transformation: Identified recoverable RAR + inferred: 7,934,500 tU <USD260/kg and 5,925,700 tU <USD130/kg. Reported/provisional 2023 production 54,345 tU. Resource/P is not reserve/P. Apply independently derived once-through cycle energy per kg; no book figure reproduced.

pvgis.title: JRC PVGIS 5.3 SARAH3/ERA5 Graz
pvgis.licence: Free reuse with attribution, JRC PVGIS usage conditions
pvgis.transformation: MRcalc horirrad=1 optrad=1 selectrad=1 angle=35 d2g=1 avtemp=1. Sum 12 monthly horizontal means across 19 years. PVcalc 35° south, free-standing c-Si, 1 kWp, 14% system losses. Satellite-derived irradiation and modelled yield, not measured station/park output. Divide kWh/m²/year by 8760 h then ×1000.

enbw_weesow.title: Weesow-Willmersdorf solar park operator commissioning facts
enbw_weesow.licence: Operator publication copyright; numerical facts only, no press image
enbw_weesow.transformation: 187 MWp, 164 ha, 180 million kWh/year expected. Derive site-boundary average and 1 GW area. Expected output is NOT a measured annual yield.

graz_boundary.title: Graz municipal boundary OGD
graz_boundary.licence: CC BY 4.0; Datenquelle: Stadt Graz – data.graz.gv.at
graz_boundary.transformation: Project boundary to EPSG32633; subtract centroid in metres, never rescale. Geometry area 127.466 km²; published city area 127.58 km² (https://www.graz.at/cms/beitrag/10034466/7772565/Zahlen_Fakten_Bevoelkerung_Bezirke_Wirtschaft.html). No OSM/ODbL data used.

sentinel.title: Sentinel-2A L2A true colour 2025-09-11
sentinel.transformation: POST STAC collection sentinel-2-l2a, bbox [13.66,52.62,13.73,52.69], June–September 2025. Chosen S2A_33UVU_20250911_0_L2A, cloud 1.469683%. Read public assets.visual COG without credentials; crop native 10 m 16 km and 5 km windows. No synthetic replacement. Credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025.

wikidata.title: Approximate park reference point
wikidata.transformation: 52.650568°N, 13.686692°E; approximate centre for imagery window, not surveyed park polygon.

owid_prices.title: Solar PV module price series
owid_prices.licence: OWID processing CC BY 4.0; Nemet/SFI CC BY 3.0, Farmer/Lafond CC BY 4.0; IRENA 2025 report permits free attributed reuse and bears © IRENA 2025; pvXchange benchmark credited
owid_prices.transformation: Saved indicator 1305867 and metadata distinguish source licences. Prices constant 2025 USD/Wp. Global estimates through 2009; European pvXchange module benchmark thereafter. Module price, not installed cost.

irena_capacity.title: Explicit photovoltaic capacity, IRENA 2026
irena_capacity.licence: © IRENA 2026; publication explicitly permits free reuse with attribution; no named CC asserted
irena_capacity.transformation: Explicit Solar photovoltaic world/Austria table, years 2016–2025, MW at year end. March table differs from later July OWID dataset. OWID installed-solar-pv-capacity slug now includes CSP; not used as PV-only. Notice: © IRENA 2026.

miller_corrigendum.title: Corrected empirical US wind/solar power densities
miller_corrigendum.transformation: Corrected capacity-weighted means: wind 0.90 W/m² (430 plants), solar 5.7 W/m² (1047 plants). Original 0.50 / 5.4 values superseded. Wind Voronoi area and solar assumed capacity-density methodology differ; preserve boundary caveat.

windeurope.title: Wind energy in Europe, 2024 statistics
windeurope.licence: Copyright WindEurope; no explicit CC verified
windeurope.transformation: Page 20 EU fleet annual CF: onshore 23%, offshore 35%, all 24%. New-farm estimates onshore 30–35%, offshore 42–55%. Facts quoted, no provider chart copied.

igwind.title: Austria wind year-end 2025
igwind.licence: Copyright IG Windkraft; numerical facts only
igwind.transformation: Actual year-end homepage: 1447 turbines, 4221 MW. Do not use older forecast brochure 1516 turbines / 4392 MW or potential annual output 9.7 TWh as measured generation.

vattenfall_hornsrev.title: Horns Rev 1 current operator facts
vattenfall_hornsrev.transformation: 20 km², current 158 MW, 80 turbines. Multiplying by EU fleet 35% gives a scenario 2.765 W/m², not a measured Horns Rev yield.

bml_area.title: Austria Facts & Figures 2024
bml_area.licence: Government publication; numerical geographical fact only
bml_area.transformation: Use published Austria area 83,884 km²; no map/page reproduced.

wna_fuel.title: Nuclear fuel-cycle benchmark
wna_fuel.transformation: Independently solve mass and isotope balances using 45 GWd/t heavy-metal burnup, 33% efficiency, 4.5% product, 0.711% natural feed, 0.22% tails. Full power year, not initial core. Compare rounded WNA 24.3 t enriched / 211 t natural U within rounding.

iaea_history.title: Nuclear Power Reactors in the World 2025, table 7
iaea_history.licence: No explicit CC licence found in report; numerical facts only
iaea_history.transformation: Extract latest available 2025 table 7, covering 1954–2024; compute maxima with SymPy. First grid connections 33 in both 1984/1985; construction starts 43 in 1976; max connected capacity 31,129 MWe in 1985. 2024 connections 6 / 6803 MWe. Historical MW values were revised since 2014; use current edition.

kkg.title: Gösgen technical main data
kkg.transformation: Net 1010 MWe, gross 1060 MWe, thermal 3002 MW; use CC-licensed Commons photo, not operator press photo.

iaea_fusion.title: IAEA fusion physics FAQ
iaea_fusion.licence: Numerical physical fact; no illustration reused
iaea_fusion.transformation: D–T Q=17.6 MeV, rounded total neutron+alpha kinetic energy.

nist_constants.title: NIST CODATA 2022
nist_constants.transformation: Atomic mass 1.66053906892e-27 kg; e=1.602176634e-19 C exact, used for eV→J.

nist_isotopes.title: NIST atomic weights / hydrogen isotopes
nist_isotopes.transformation: D 2.01410177812 u; T 3.0160492779 u; molecular water model 18.01528 u. Atomic rather than bare-nucleus masses change fuel mass negligibly at teaching precision.

nist_units.title: NIST SP811 unit conversion
nist_units.transformation: International Table Btu=1055.05585262 J, not thermochemical Btu.

nist_vsmow.title: NIST TN1900 VSMOW isotope reference
nist_vsmow.transformation: D/H atomic ratio 155.76e-6; D fraction is r/(1+r), with two H sites per water molecule. Seawater variation neglected in inventory estimate.

noaa_ocean.title: NOAA ocean volume
noaa_ocean.transformation: Ocean volume 1.335 billion km³; multiply model D concentration, not an extraction reserve.

usgs_lithium.title: USGS MCS 2026 lithium
usgs_lithium.transformation: World Li reserves 37 Mt elemental Li; production 290 kt excludes withheld US value. Reserve is not all Li-6, nor recoverable tritium fuel.

assumptions.title: Explicit lecturer/model assumptions
assumptions.licence: Original teaching derivations CC BY 4.0; code MIT
assumptions.transformation: 365-day year; PV efficiency 20%; densities 0.5/2/10/20 W/m²; coal LHV 24 MJ/kg; seawater 1025 kg/m³, water fraction 0.965; 30-year deployment, 90% nuclear CF. These are scenario assumptions, not observed universal constants.

faostat_arable.title: Arable land per person, FAO via World Bank WDI
faostat_arable.licence: FAO database default CC BY 4.0; WDI and OWID processing CC BY 4.0
faostat_arable.transformation: World and Austria 2023, hectares per person. Values are replotted independently; credit FAO, World Bank and OWID processing.

hyde_cropland.title: Cropland per person, PBL HYDE 3.5 via OWID
hyde_cropland.licence: OWID processing CC BY 4.0; source PBL HYDE 3.5 has no separate licence identified in available metadata
hyde_cropland.transformation: World and Austria 2023, hectares per person. Cropland comprises arable plus permanent crops; credit PBL/HYDE and OWID processing. No standalone CC licence asserted for HYDE.

usda_corn.title: US corn yield, USDA NASS Crop Production 2024 Summary
usda_corn.transformation: National corn average yield 179.3 bushels/acre. Used only as an illustrative gross energy-per-cropland-area factor.

doe_ethanol.title: Ethanol output and lower heating value, US DOE AFDC
doe_ethanol.transformation: Dry-mill ethanol output 2.8 gal/bushel and pure ethanol LHV 76,330 Btu/gal. Farm/distillery energy and coproduct credit are excluded.

loss_cats.title: Free-ranging domestic cat bird mortality, Loss et al. 2013 corrected
loss_cats.licence: Only factual estimates re-plotted; source article rights remain separate
loss_cats.transformation: Corrected estimate 1.3–4.0 billion birds/year in contiguous US from free-ranging cats; a model estimate, not a count.

loss_buildings.title: Bird-building collisions, Loss et al. 2014
loss_buildings.licence: Only numerical facts re-plotted; source article rights remain separate
loss_buildings.transformation: United States annual estimate 365–988 million, median 599 million.

loss_vehicles.title: Bird-vehicle collisions, Loss et al. 2014
loss_vehicles.licence: Only numerical facts re-plotted; source article rights remain separate
loss_vehicles.transformation: United States road estimate 89–340 million birds/year.

loss_powerlines.title: Power-line bird mortality, Loss et al. 2014
loss_powerlines.transformation: United States collision plus electrocution estimate 12–64 million birds/year; no source figure reproduced.

loss_wind.title: Bird mortality at US wind facilities, Loss et al. 2013
loss_wind.licence: Only numerical facts re-plotted; source article rights remain separate
loss_wind.transformation: Contiguous US monopole turbine estimate 140,438–327,586 deaths/year; mean 234,012.

naturvardsverket_birds.title: European wind-farm mortality synthesis, Vindval Report 6511
naturvardsverket_birds.licence: Swedish Environmental Protection Agency review; numerical fact only
naturvardsverket_birds.transformation: Median 6.5 birds/turbine/year across reviewed European wind farms; site estimates are heterogeneous and skewed, not a Europe-wide total.

owid_deaths.title: Deaths per TWh electricity, OWID compilation
owid_deaths.licence: OWID processing CC BY 4.0; cited underlying evidence has varied boundaries
owid_deaths.transformation: Markandya & Wilkinson (2007), Sovacool et al. (2016), UNSCEAR (2008/2018); air-pollution and accident estimates combined. Original plot only.

ipcc_candidate.title: IPCC AR5 WGIII Annex III lifecycle emissions candidate
ipcc_candidate.licence: IPCC default terms limit reuse to personal non-commercial use; excluded under course rule
ipcc_candidate.transformation: Checked Table A.III.2 values and then excluded the series because published reuse terms are non-commercial; no IPCC numbers or figure are in processed outputs.

nrel_lifecycle.title: Life Cycle Emissions Factors for Electricity Generation Technologies
nrel_lifecycle.licence: DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE custom terms permit free use/copy with the full notice attached and require publication credit; no CC licence asserted
nrel_lifecycle.transformation: Subset of total lifecycle min/median/max columns W/Y/AA for nine technology groups. Own plot; no source figure reproduced. Credit DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE. The full source notice is embedded in the processed CSV and each plot-data output.

who_cooking_candidate.title: OWID WHO clean-cooking grapher
who_cooking_candidate.licence: WHO CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; OWID processing CC BY 4.0 does not override it
who_cooking_candidate.transformation: Research candidate only. Original WHO indicator licence verified in OWID source metadata; do not relabel CC BY.

ei_candidate.title: OWID energy/GDP original candidate
ei_candidate.licence: OWID own processing CC BY 4.0; underlying Energy Institute copyright
ei_candidate.transformation: Saved for comparison only. EIA public-domain alternative used instead. OWID licensing cannot override EI source terms.
